title: Smoke Detector Beep
blurb: The smoke detector low-battery chirp — a single high beep, then silence, then madness. It is the most psychologically hostile sound in any home: impossible to locate, impossible to ignore, and arriving on an interval just long enough that you start doubting you heard it. Manufacturers made it that way deliberately so it can't be tuned out, which is exactly what makes it elite prank material. Play it near someone and watch them dismantle a ceiling. Deploy responsibly; this one genuinely ruins evenings.
origin: The universal low-battery chirp of smoke detectors everywhere.
